title: Cloudflare Pages publication
responsibility: Deploys a prepared report bundle through the configured Pages project.

inputs.name: reportPages.bundle
inputs.description: Prepared publication directory, report identifier and optional revision.

outputs.name: reportPages
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the first deployment URL matching the configured Pages project in command output. Runs pinned Wrangler 4.93.0 against a report-specific branch, supplying account and configuration-home environment values.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects an invalid project name, missing Cloudflare account, failed deployment command or missing deployment URL. Configuration and subprocess errors may also propagate.
